content.content: 1. Necessity: the prose prerequisites leave something only a machine-checkable artifact can settle — what counts as conforming — so the manifest cannot be dropped without loss. Fail if it could. 2. Fidelity, both directions: the manifest enforces exactly what its prerequisites claim — no stricter, no looser, nothing smuggled in. Fail on divergence in either direction; name the diverging rule.
content.rationale: The manifest is a tool-checkable artifact derived from prose prerequisites; a reviewer read-through of both directions — no stricter, no looser — is the whole applicable check.
